key_point: Pokémon nearly bankrupted its studio during six years of development
title: Pokémon took six years to make and almost bankrupted its studio.
caption: Pokémon took six years to make and almost bankrupted its studio. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #pokemon #gamefreak #gameboy

instagram.caption:
Pokémon took six years to make and almost bankrupted its studio.

Game Freak ran out of money along the way. Several staff quit, and creator Satoshi Tajiri stopped taking a salary and lived off his father.

It came out in 1996 on the aging Game Boy, when few expected anything from it. It is now the highest-grossing media franchise ever.
